The collapse is attributable to the academic block rather than to SES: academic characteristics alone already render the race gap non-significant (Black +0.1481, p=0.50), whereas SES alone attenuates it by only 14-17% and leaves it highly significant (Black −0.7497, p=0.0003); within the block the ASVAB ability composite is the active mediator (race 2-df p=0.37 with ability entered vs p=0.002 with only class percentile).
